values.note: Linn County 2025 schedule: $19 a night with 30 A, up to $23 with 50 A, water and sewer; tents $13, extra tent $10. Every vehicle also needs a parking pass: $5 a day, or $30 a year from out of county ($20 for county residents).
Campsites are first come, first served; cabins and shelter houses by phone reservation with the park.

note: Linn County park and marina on 2,600-acre La Cygne Lake (ranked among the top 100 US bass lakes): wooded loops with 30- and 50-amp sites, shower house with laundry, rental cabins, marina store with bait and licences. No swimming or water skiing. Daily $5 parking pass per vehicle. --Claude
